changelog:
- Removed all user question parameters and storage, enhancing privacy.
- Updated payment/order interface: order creation no longer requires a question argument.
- Order metadata now only contains system-generated fields (no user content or lottery data).
- Updated documentation with precise privacy and data usage statements.
- Removed argparse dependency related to user input handling.
summary: SSQ (Double Color Ball) lottery intelligent analysis: fetches official draw data from cwl.gov.cn, computes hot/cold statistics, frequency distributions, AC values, odd-even ratios, and zone distributions. Paid tier (3.9 yuan/run) delivers 5 recommended number sets via clawtip payment.
